The '''8880 Limousine''' was produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] and intended for use as a pleasure craft and secure transport by the rich and famous. The passenger area was fitted with two large, comfortable benches and was well armored. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] employed these vehicles for transporting visiting officials and dignitaries. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] office in [[Selkren]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]] had four 8880 Limousines in its motorpool.<ref name="I" />
